hub.speaker: Tier Clerk
hub.text: State your business and your sponsor.

text_variants.text: State your business. The tier's night ledger takes entries until last bell, and past that it — you there, papers only on the ledge. State your business.
A Human, this far in. State your business and your sponsor. Sponsors get checked twice for Humans, so have the name ready.
Papers, then, same as everyone through this gate. Sponsor's name, and don't waste my morning.
Posted rate, same as everyone. I don't set the price and I don't move it, whatever they taught you to say back home.

text_variants._comment: v0.15 T4.1 market ambient reactivity — same ordering rule as pallass_market_local.json's pair.
text_variants.text: You're carrying a forge-tier stamp. That's the permit office's business, and they keep their own ledger of it. State whatever this window is for.
Liscor sends word that its seal is settled. Here that is one line in one dispatch, filed. State your business.

options.text: Papers for Pallass, filed and attuned. (2 gold)
There's a crate of tin held in your own queue.

stamped.speaker: Tier Clerk
stamped.text: Stamped. Market tier, until you've got cause for more. Mind the queues.

queue_entry.speaker: Tier Clerk
queue_entry.text: Held correctly. The entry side is mine, and the entry side is clear. The release side belongs to the forge office, and I cannot endorse a release I do not hold. I can endorse the entry as clean. Take that to the permit window and ask for the countersign. Next.

options.text: Then endorse the entry, and I'll take it up.
So I queue again at a different window.

queue_entry_done.speaker: Tier Clerk
queue_entry_done.text: Stamped, dated, and correct. Take it to the permit window. Do not say I sent you. Say the entry is endorsed, which is what the stamp says.
